title: Cold Storage Manual
text: Cedar Annex cold storage manual. The standard cold storage freezer alarm threshold is minus twelve degrees Celsius. The backup probe is mounted beside the blue door. Log every excursion before resetting the control panel.

title: Cold Storage Manual
text: After a cold storage power cut, keep the freezer doors shut for forty minutes. Call the duty engineer before transferring trays to a standby cabinet.

title: Cold Storage Manual
text: The weekly freezer inspection form is filed in the green binder. Use the standard incident log before resetting the control panel.

title: Water Sampling Guide
text: Cedar Annex water sampling guide. River samples are collected upstream of the footbridge. Use an amber glass bottle for the nitrate sample.

title: Water Sampling Guide
text: Water sampling custody forms require the sampler and receiver signatures. Carry completed forms in the green binder. Use the standard incident log before resetting the control panel.

title: Water Sampling Guide
text: Store the calibration solution in the locked west cabinet. A water sampling meter must be rinsed twice with deionized water before calibration.

title: Dispatch Handbook

title: Dispatch Handbook
text: Overnight dispatch staging uses bay four. The dispatch desk calls the duty engineer if the loading gate jams.
